items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: I think Chester Jones the one I know is a drummer.

ctx.x: In the Renee's band? Let's see who was in the band. There was a banjo player, Chester Jones I know the bass player was in the band. Chester Jones was one and Zeb the Klanet player. Zeb. You might have heard talk about Zeb.
I think Chester Jones the one I know is a drummer. No it was Chester Zarder.
Oh Zarder. Chester Zarder. That was the bass player. Oh yes I know him too. And you had Renee and you had Morris and you had my daddy and you had the drummer. The drummer was Renee's brother.
